pinned_reachable.why: control: the pinned rule is safe while every attempt can reach the provider

pinned_outage.why: CP-F4: a lost response, then an outage, then the deadline; confirmed on the runtime by contract probe CP-F4

pinned_skew_reachable.why: clock skew alone does not break it; CP-F1 also needs the later attempt to be unable to reach the provider

confirmfinal_all.why: making a confirmation final does not help when the operation closes before the earlier attempt reports

sticky_all.why: uncertainty sticky alone holds under outage, crash and skew

sticky_confirmfinal_all.why: both rules together hold under outage, crash and skew

sticky_confirmfinal_dispatch_after_expir.why: aeoess/federation-port#1 at a134e94: past the deadline a retry is still dispatched, so the first request can come after the authorization expired

read_only_after_expiry.why: the rule asked for in review: nothing is dispatched after the deadline; all four invariants hold under outage, crash and skew

reconcile_naive_absent.why: federation-port#2 failure case 1: an authoritative absence closes the operation, then the earlier request reaches the provider and settles

reconcile_final.why: the candidate rule: absence closes only on key-scoped finality inside retention, retries and lookups bounded by retention, durable budget, and under the sweep assumption every unknown operation settles or reaches an operator

reconcile_no_retention_bound.why: a retry sent after the retention window reaches a provider that forgot the key: a second refund

reconcile_unbounded_delivery.why: timing assumption T3 is load-bearing: a retry sent inside the window that arrives after the provider forgot the key is a second refund

reconcile_effect_after_expiry.why: federation-port#2 failure case 2: no dispatch after the deadline, yet a request sent before it settles after it; the runtime cannot prevent this, only record it

reconcile_volatile_budget.why: a budget or status that a restart resets lets reconciliation loop without end; budgets must survive restarts (liveness: TLC may report another lasso, so only the property and the loop are compared; example_trace is one such run)

reconcile_no_scheduling.why: operator_required within a bounded number of steps needs the scheduling assumption S1: without a caller or a sweep nothing happens (liveness: TLC may report another lasso, so only the property and the loop are compared; example_trace is one such run)

reconcile_misreported_final.why: finality is the provider's guarantee: a provider that reports a pending request as final absence makes the closure wrong

reconcile_misreport_contradiction.why: even with a misreporting provider, a contradicting confirmation wins and is never invented
